verses.en: Qaf By the glorious Quran!
verses.ar: قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ

verses.en: But the disbelievers are amazed that a warner has come from among them and they say, ‘How strange!
verses.ar: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ

verses.en: To come back [to life] after we have died and become dust? That is too farfetched.’
verses.ar: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ

verses.en: We know very well what the earth takes away from them: We keep a comprehensive record.
verses.ar: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَـٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ

verses.en: But the disbelievers deny the truth when it comes to them; they are in a state of confusion.
verses.ar: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ

verses.en: Do they not see the sky above them––how We have built and adorned it, with no rifts in it;
verses.ar: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ

verses.en: how We spread out the earth and put solid mountains on it, and caused every kind of joyous plant to grow in it,
verses.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ

verses.en: as a lesson and reminder for every servant who turns to God;
verses.ar: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ

verses.en: and how We send blessed water down from the sky and grow with it gardens, the harvest grain,
verses.ar: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَـٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ

verses.en: and tall palm trees laden with clusters of dates,
verses.ar: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَـٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ

verses.en: as a provision for everyone; how with water We give [new] life to a land that is dead? This is how the dead will emerge [from their graves].
verses.ar: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ

verses.en: The people of Noah disbelieved long before these disbelievers, as did the people of Rass, Thamud,
verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ

verses.en: Ad, Pharaoh, Lot,
verses.ar: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ

verses.en: the Forest-Dwellers, Tubba: all of these people disbelieved their messengers, and so My warning was realized.
verses.ar: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ ۚ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ

verses.en: So were We incapable of the first creation? No indeed! Yet they doubt a second creation.
verses.ar: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ

verses.en: We created man––We know what his soul whispers to him: We are closer to him than his jugular vein––
verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ

verses.en: with two receptors set to record, one on his right side and one on his left:
verses.ar: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ

verses.en: he does not utter a single word without an ever-present watcher.
verses.ar: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ

verses.en: The trance of death will bring the Truth with it: ‘This is what you tried to escape.’
verses.ar: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ

verses.en: The Trumpet will be sounded: ‘This is the Day [you were] warned of.’
verses.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ

verses.en: Each person will arrive attended by an [angel] to drive him on and another to bear witness:
verses.ar: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ

verses.en: ‘You paid no attention to this [Day]; but today We have removed your veil and your sight is sharp.’
verses.ar: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ

verses.en: The person’s attendant will say, ‘Here is what I have prepared’-
verses.ar: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ

verses.en: ‘Hurl every obstinate disbeliever into Hell,
verses.ar: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ

verses.en: everyone who hindered good, was aggressive, caused others to doubt,
verses.ar: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ

verses.en: and set up other gods alongside God. Hurl him into severe punishment!’-
verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ

verses.en: and his [evil] companion will say, ‘Lord, I did not make him transgress; he had already gone far astray himself.’
verses.ar: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ

verses.en: God will say, ‘Do not argue in My presence. I sent you a warning
verses.ar: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ

verses.en: and My word cannot be changed: I am not unjust to any creature.’
verses.ar: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ

verses.en: We shall say to Hell on that day, ‘Are you full?’ and it will reply, ‘Are there no more?’
verses.ar: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ

verses.en: But Paradise will be brought close to the righteous and will no longer be distant:
verses.ar: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ

verses.en: ‘This is what you were promised––this is for everyone who turned often to God and kept Him in mind,
verses.ar: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ

verses.en: who held the Most Gracious in awe, though He is unseen, who comes before Him with a heart turned to Him in devotion-
verses.ar: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ

verses.en: so enter it in peace. This is the Day of everlasting Life.’
verses.ar: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ

verses.en: They will have all that they wish for there, and We have more for them.
verses.ar: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ

verses.en: We have destroyed even mightier generations before these disbelievers, who travelled through [many] lands- was there any escape?
verses.ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ

verses.en: There truly is a reminder in this for whoever has a heart, whoever listens attentively.
verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ

verses.en: We created the heavens, the earth, and everything between, in six Days without tiring.
verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ

verses.en: So [Prophet], bear everything they say with patience; celebrate the praise of your Lord before the rising and setting of the sun;
verses.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ

verses.en: proclaim His praise in the night and at the end of every prayer;
verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ

verses.en: listen out for the Day when the caller will call from a nearby place.
verses.ar: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ

verses.en: They will come out [from their graves] on that Day, the Day when they hear the mighty blast in reality.
verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ

verses.en: It is We who give life and death; the final return will be to Us
verses.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ

verses.en: on the Day when the earth will be torn apart, letting them rush out- that gathering will be easy for Us.
verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ

verses.en: We know best what the disbelievers say. You [Prophet] are not there to force them, so remind, with this Quran, those who fear My warning.
verses.ar: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
